title: Run configuration loading permits arbitrary code execution
reasoning: Every discovered run's config.yaml is parsed with yaml.unsafe_load during startup. Python object constructors in a supplied run configuration can execute code with the dashboard process's permissions, before score verification occurs.
reproduction: Include a config.yaml containing a Python object/application tag in a discovered run directory. Starting the dashboard invokes its constructor during metadata loading.
recommendation: Use safe YAML loading and validate the resulting configuration structure. If custom tags are necessary, register only explicitly permitted non-executing constructors.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included load_run tests replace load_config_metadata with a stub and never exercise YAML parsing.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise real configuration loading with ordinary configuration mappings and Python object tags; assert ordinary metadata loads and executable tags are rejected without invoking constructors.
